Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 24-Dec-2024 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.Tech. (CORE STREAM) DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2024 / JANUARY 2025  
  SUBJECT: CSE 1071/CSE_1071- PROBLEM SOLVING USING COMPUTERS  
  (MAKEUP/REGULAR)  
  
  
  PROBLEM SOLVING USING COMPUTERS [CSE 1071]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                     Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               Write the basic structure of a C Program. Explain each section briefly with suitable examples.           (3)  
1B)               List the rules for valid variable names in C. State whether the following variable names are valid or    (3)  
  invalid.  
  i) 3int  
  ii) n_1  
  iii) _abc  
  iv) x&y  
1C)               Write a C program using nested if-else statements to check whether a student is eligible for a           (4)  
  scholarship. The user needs to enter the total marks of six subjects (each out of 100), and the  
  program should check the student's eligibility for the scholarship. The student is given  
  i) a full scholarship if the total mark is greater than or equal to 540,  
  ii) a 50% scholarship if the total mark is greater than or equal to 480, and  
  iii) 20% if the total mark is greater than or equal to 400.  
  No marks other than those mentioned are not eligible for the scholarship.  
2A)               i) Describe the use of the continue statement.                                                           (3)  
  ii) Write a C program that demonstrates the use of the continue statement. The program should  
  accept n numbers from the user and counts how many of them are divisible by 3.  
2B)               i) Write the syntax of the strcmp( ) function in a C program, and explain its possible return values     (4)  
  and their occurrences.  
  ii) A one-dimensional integer array arr is made up of the elements 5, 2, 9, 1, 3, 6. It is required to  
  sort the array in the ascending order using the selection sort algorithm. Demonstrate by hand  
  calculation, the number of swaps performed by the algorithm to sort the given array. DO NOT write  
  a C program and/or algorithm.  
2C)               i) Write the C-program-syntax for simultaneously declaring and initializing a 2D array in a single       (3)  
  statement. Also give an example.  
  ii) Write a C program to read a square matrix and display the same, but the principal diagonal  
  elements must be displayed as zeros.  
3A)               Write a C program with a function findMax( ) that takes three integers as parameters and returns         (2)  
  the largest number. Show in the program the function prototype declaration, actual parameters in  
  the function call, and formal parameters in the function definition.  
3B)               Write a C program that uses both local and global variables, and hence explain the difference            (4)  
  between local and global variables.  
3C)               Define recursion. Explain the steps to design a recursive algorithm. Also discuss the advantages         (4)  
  and limitations of recursion.  
  
  Page 1 of 2

4A)   Write a C program that uses a function to swap the values of two variables using pointers. Explain    (3)  
  why pointers are necessary in this context.  
4B)   Write a C program to demonstrate the nesting of functions to find the sum and product of integers     (4)  
  as defined below:  
  i) Function sum( ) should take two integers and return their sum.  
  ii) Function multiply( ) should take two integers, call the function sum( ) to compute the sum, and  
  return the product of the sum and a third integer.  
  iii) In main( ), call the function multiply( ) and display the result.  
4C)   Write a C program to define a structure Student with the following fields:                            (3)  
  
  RollNo (an integer) - a unique whole number to identify a student,  
  Name (a string) - to store the name of the student, and  
  CGPA (a float) - to store the overall grade of the student.  
  
  The program should find the student with the highest marks in an array of 5 students.  
5A)   Write a C program that defines a structure Employee with the fields:                                  (3)  
  
  CompanyName (a string) - to store the name of the company of the employee,  
  EmpName (a string) - to store the name of the employee  
  EmpID (an integer) - to store the unique identity number of the employee,  
  Salary (a float) - to store the annual salary of the employee.  
  
  The program should create an array of 5 employees and display the details of the employee with  
  the highest salary.  
5B)   Given the following array and pointer declaration:                                                    (4)  
  $$int arr[ ] = {10, 20, 30, 40, 50};$$  
  $$int *ptr = arr;$$  
  Write a C program that:  
  i) Prints the first element of the array using pointer dereferencing.  
  ii) Uses pointers to print the third element of the array.  
  iii) Increments the pointer and prints the value it points to after the increment.  
5C)   Explain briefly the simple measures that can provide effective computer security.                     (3)  
  
  
  -----End-----
